description:
# Kick off Sail 250 week with a spectacular night on the water!

Step aboard and cruise past the excited crowds along Boston’s shoreline as we take in the harbor sights and the impressive fleet gathered for this historic celebration. After a relaxing evening on the water, settle in for a breathtaking fireworks display launched over Boston Harbor in honor of Sail 250.

Your ticket includes one complimentary drink, with additional beverages available for purchase.

Join us for a two-hour harbor cruise, followed by a front-row view of the Sail 250 fireworks lighting up the Boston Waterfront.

# Notable Highlights

- The best vantage point for the Sail 250 fireworks — unobstructed views from the water.

- Within minutes of leaving the dock, you’ll leave the city behind and enjoy the peaceful, sweeping views of Boston’s skyline.

- Experience the harbor’s festive atmosphere, the tall ships, and an unforgettable fireworks display unlike anything seen from land.

Please note: Due to increased harbor traffic and vessel lighting requirements during the fireworks show, we may not be able to raise sail during this event. If conditions allow, we may enjoy a short sail after the fireworks.

*Please note that the fireworks are weather permitting*

****************************

##About Adirondack
Inspired by the pilot schooners of the 1890’s, Classic Harbor Line’s Adirondack is 80-ft in length, features teak decks, mahogany-trimmings, complete with 2 bathrooms, and just under 2,000 square feet of canvas to escort you through Boston’s historic harbor!
Though it is a light and lively sailing vessel, it is also quite comfortable, with ample deck space and seating for up to 41. It was designed and built by Scarano Boat Building of Albany, NY for taking groups of people on spectacular sightseeing adventures.
Sailing in this schooner is a delight. She moves through the water efficiently and beautifully; we take great pride in sharing her with you.
The Adirondack III is operated by Coast Guard-certified captains and an extremely friendly and talented crew. Our crew is known for their amazing hospitality, and are professionally trained and experienced in sailing our vessels well and safely. Do not hesitate to ask our crew about the boat or any of the Boston sites.
